answer_1.quote: Researchers have reformulated decompilation as a translation exercise, converting machine-level instructions into readable source code.

answer_2.quote: We follow previous work to calculate the re-executability rate. ... we access the readability of decompiled results in terms of Edit Similarity score.

answer_3.quote: We further employed GPT-4o to evaluate readability. Specifically, we guide GPT to assess syntax similarity (variables, loops, conditions) and structural integrity (logic flow, structure) using a structured template.
methods: GPT-based readability evaluation using structured template
